text:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod failed for release v2026.03.20-rc8 — staging artifact index shows inconsistent chunk ordering, failing integrity check.
jonathan: saw this on the staging smoke run, chrome wheel import fails with 'zipfile.BadZipFile: File is not a zip file' :grimace:
sre-elena: artifacts list shows multiple object names like artifacts/rc8/part-000{3,1,2}.tar.gz — ordering seems non-deterministic in the compose step.
maria: is this from the upload retry logic? builder retries might be composing parts concurrently.
devex-ania: confirmed builder logs show parallel chunk uploads then a `gsutil compose` with parts in lexicographic order, but the artifact index recorded original upload order.
jonathan: snippet from builder log:```bash
# builder step
for part in $(ls parts/); do gsutil cp $part gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/$part &
done
wait
gsutil compose gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/part-* gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/wheel-rc8.tar.gz
```
sre-elena: when parts arrive concurrently ls/expansion order isn't guaranteed, so compose can reorder. That will corrupt concatenated archives.
deploy-bot: Stage promotion failed, check run 5832. Action: HOLD — manual decision required.
maria: options: 1) pin prod to v2026.03.20-rc7 (last good), 2) trigger a deterministic reupload with ordered part names and re-composed artifact, 3) rebuild entirely.
jonathan: rebuilding will take 40m, reupload+compose from existing parts about 10m if we can lock ordering.
release-czar: change window is 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC. We need a decision within the hour.
devex-ania: I can run a one-off compose with explicit ordering: `gsutil compose gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/part-0001 gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/part-0002 ...` once parts are verified. Will also run `unzip -t` on the result.
sre-elena: quick verification steps: `gsutil ls -r gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/` and then `gsutil compose` in the recorded build order (we have a build_metadata.json with part sequence). If metadata missing, risky.
maria: do we have build_metadata.json in the artifact bucket? jonathan — can you check run artifacts for rc8?
jonathan: checked: run artifacts show `build_metadata.json` with `parts_order: ["part-0001","part-0002","part-0003","part-0004"]`. Great.
release-czar: I propose: hold promotion, pin prod to rc7, then run deterministic compose and smoke verify on a staging copy. If verified, manual promote outside change window only for critical patch; otherwise schedule for change window.
sre-elena: vote +1 for pin+compose. Minimizes risk.
maria: +1. jonathan?
jonathan: +1. I'll run the compose and smoke tests after pin.
deploy-bot: Executing pin: promoted-image -> v2026.03.20-rc7 (manual override by @release-czar).
devex-ania: commands I'll run (will report back):
```bash
# copy parts into ordered list and compose
ORDER=(part-0001 part-0002 part-0003 part-0004)
for p in "${ORDER[@]}"; do echo "gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/$p"; done > /tmp/parts.txt
# compose explicitly in order
gsutil compose $(cat /tmp/parts.txt) gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/wheel-rc8-composed.tar.gz
# verify
gsutil cp gs://redwood-artifacts/rc8/wheel-rc8-composed.tar.gz /tmp/ && unzip -t /tmp/wheel-rc8-composed.tar.gz
```
jonathan: if unzip -t passes, I'll run the staging smoke suite (smoke: quick import + run basic server).
sre-elena: also recommend adding a small CI check: ensure builder writes a manifest with deterministic indices to avoid this recurring. Filing ticket now.
release-czar: file the ticket and add to next sprint. Put release note line: "Hotfix: artifact compose ordering causing rc8 promotion hold; pinned to rc7; deterministic compose planned." Link to PR when ready.
maria: can someone add short blurb to internal release-notes draft? I'll add placeholder: `See task ARTIFACT-452`
devex-ania: running compose now — will post result.
deploy-bot: update: compose started at 3412346801.
devex-ania: compose finished, `unzip -t` reports OK. Uploading composed artifact to staging copy.
jonathan: running staging smoke (quick import) now.
jonathan: smoke passed (basic import + unit smoke). Good.
release-czar: consensus: pin prod to rc7 now, schedule manual promote of rc8 only after verification and release note. I'll do the pin.
deploy-bot: Pin complete. prod points to v2026.03.20-rc7.
maria: thanks all — add a line to release-notes draft referencing ARTIFACT-452 and link to logs: https://internal.redwood/builds/5832/logs.
sre-elena: ticket ARTIFACT-452 created: "Ensure deterministic part ordering and manifest emit on chunked uploads". Assigning to devex-ania.
devex-ania: ack, will PR a manifest writer and composer helper.
release-czar: decision recorded. We'll re-evaluate next steps in the change window if rc8 needs urgent push. Otherwise postpone to scheduled deploy.
jonathan: leaving notes for on-call: composer helper ready; watchstaging link: https://staging.redwood/smoke/5832. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: thread closed by manual decision at 3412349401.
